class.comment: Generate anonymous POST /connect/device/authorize, authenticated GET /connect/device?userCode={value}, and authenticated POST /connect/device/approve endpoints. Validate the enabled feature, active OAuth Client, allowed device_code grant, and case-sensitive allowed Scopes. Issue a high-entropy one-way-hashed Device Code and an unambiguous uppercase eight-character User Code rendered four-plus-four, with case-insensitive and hyphen-insensitive canonical lookup. Return verification URI, verification URI complete, configured expiry defaulting to 900 seconds, and polling interval defaulting to 5 seconds. Review exposes pending client name, requested Scopes, expiry, and status only to an authenticated Active User; approval or denial records the User and lifecycle atomically. Polling enforces interval and expiry and returns authorization_pending, slow_down, access_denied, expired_token, or invalid_grant as required. The first valid approved poll atomically issues credentials and marks the Device Grant redeemed; later polls, inactive or mismatched principals, unknown codes, and disallowed Scopes issue no credential.
class.name: SecurityAuthorityDeviceEndpoints
